第一卷 重生归来 第十六章 天雷滚滚和重口味
这时，大门口一阵喧哗，只见青木饭店的老板王海龙一溜小跑到饭店门口，一脸恭敬的将一群人请了进去。
“来了。”
陶泽西低下头小声的说。
“那个走在中间，右眉上长了一颗痣的就是青木的土皇帝，章福民，他左边的是李万生。”
早在那群人进来的时候，苏芮就已经“看”到了章福民和李万生的过去。当章福民那群人消失在楼梯转口，陶泽西才收回了注意力，刚想问苏芮发现了什么，却发现苏芮早就开始吃上了。
“喂，你怎么吃上了，现在人都上楼了，想看也看不到了。”那语气，颇有点恨铁不成钢。
“我看这菜再不吃就要凉了，而凉了就不好吃了。那多浪费啊，你也快点吃啊。我一个人可吃不完，这大盘鸡真心赞！”
看着苏芮吃的那么香，弄得陶泽西也觉得饿了，然后他也拿起筷子和苏芮开始了抢食大战。
“你看到李万生了？有没有看出什么？”陶泽西看苏芮吃的差不多了便开口问道。
“隔墙有耳，去你住的地方再说。”
“你真的看出了什么？”陶泽西关上门就急急的问道。
苏芮看到陶泽西急躁的样子，悠闲的坐在椅子上，眼中充满笑意。
“唔，我有点渴了。”
陶泽西看她大有你不给我水喝我就不开口的架势，无奈只能去给她倒了一杯水。
苏芮接过水杯，沿着杯沿轻抿一口，终于在陶泽西忍不住又要开口时放下了水杯。
“我确实看出了一些事情，这个李万生，跟章福民明显不合，虽然面上看起来李万生是对章福民马首是瞻，而且还娶了章福民的妹妹章玉凤，这样让他们更是绑在了一起，但是如果章福民对李万生又杀子之恨呢？他还会和章福民同一条心嘛？”
苏芮说的轻描淡写，可她越轻描淡写，陶泽西越是惊讶，她是如何知道章福民对李万生有杀子之恨的？这么重要的信息，就连他这个特种兵都没调查出来，而这个十四岁的小姑娘居然见一面李万生就能得到这样的消息，如果这是真的，那苏芮到底是什么人？
这实在是让陶泽西太震惊了，他用疑惑和审视的目光看着苏芮。
苏芮看到陶泽西眼底的疑惑和审视，轻笑出声。

“干嘛这样看着我，我们有共同的敌人不是么？”
“你…你是不是会看相？”陶泽西小心翼翼的问出口。
“呵，差不多吧。你也可以这么认为。”
陶泽西很快就调整好自己的表情，但是看着苏芮的表情带着一丝敬畏。也许很多人不相信风水术数，但是他确实是相信的，那些大人物的权利越大越相信这些，而且他执行任务的时候也遇到过凡力解释不了的事情。火狮就有风水顾问，每当他们遇到解释不了的灵异事件就需要风水顾问出面解决了。所以也由不得他不信。
“至于李万生收集的证据，你可以去他的那个青梅竹马唐雪的住所去找。就在卧室衣柜之中的抽屉里，而章福民那边你可以去查查他妻子的妹妹阿依古丽的银行账户。”
陶泽西神色很复杂，相术能看这么详细？如果真的能，那苏芮岂不是比那些什么玄学大师还要厉害么？可是她才多大啊。说出去肯定不会有人相信的。
苏芮本来只想看下李万生的过去的，可是却没想到同时遇到了章福民，如果是前一天同时遇到了两个人，那么她也只能看透一个，谁让她功力太弱呐。她能一下看透两个还多亏了那四个夜明珠，昨晚她师傅离开书房后，她就拿着夜明珠打量，谁知那夜明珠中竟然蕴含着紫气，那紫气正一点点的流入她的身体，若不是她正在观察那个夜明珠她根本就不会发现，既然知道了夜明珠中蕴含着紫气，苏芮就断然没有放过的道理，不过她还是小心的吸光了第一颗夜明珠，在发现那个夜明珠没有什么变化之后，她就放心大胆的将其他三个也吸收了。吸收其他三个苏芮可就没有什么顾忌了，所以很快就吸收完了，当她吸收完第四个夜明珠的时候，她发现她就要突破第一重了，这是她第一次突破，自然不敢怠慢，马上盘腿入定。终于在破晓之时，借助天地间的紫气成功的突破了。所以她今天才能“看”了两个人的过去却一点也不吃力。苏芮默默的在心中为祖师爷天玑子点了三十二个赞。这真是一个超级大金手指啊。
至于李万生和章福民的的过去，还真让苏芮不忍直视，他们其中一个是狗血加天雷滚滚的都市苦情鸳鸯，另一个就是重口味两姐妹共事一夫。
话说李万生之前也是一个想要为人民鞠躬尽瘁死而后已的有志青年，结果来到青木县之后呢，现实将他的理想摔的稀巴烂。那时候，在青木县，章福民已经是土皇帝了，而章福民觉得李万生很有才干，就像让李万生做他的左膀右臂，李万生有心对抗章福民，可是差点把自己玩进去，没办法，只能和章福民同流合污了。然后他也慢慢地感受到了金钱带给他的好处，所以就迷失在金钱中不可自拔了。
李万生本来想着，这样也很好的，在这站稳脚跟，然后把青梅竹马的恋人也接过来，然后结婚生子。在青木县，他也算是一人之下万人之上了，完全可以给自己的恋人一个好生活。他想的很好，可惜人算终究不如天算，章福民为了加固自己跟李万生的关系，要把自己那个比李万生大八岁的妹妹嫁给他，李万生本来是不想娶的，可是章福民却用他犯罪的证据逼他娶章玉凤。
他之前也是一个有理想有血性的汉子，更何况他心中已经有了爱人了，他不能对不起他的青梅竹马啊，最后还是他的青梅竹马恋人劝他娶章玉凤，还对他说自己愿意做小，最后李万生只能和章玉凤结婚了。
自从李万生和章玉凤结婚后，他就在青木县又买了一处房子，将自己的爱人接过来，来个金窝藏娇。章福民是知道李万生在外面养了个小的，他却觉得这没什么，男人么，三妻四妾的很正常，更何况他也是这样。他也是这样安慰自己妹妹的。可是当李万生的青梅竹马怀孕的时候章福民不淡定了，就算李万生想要孩子也只能自己妹妹生啊。结婚的纽带太脆弱，只要自己妹妹生了他的孩子，那他就肯定不会背叛章家了。所以他就让人将唐雪弄流产了，虽然表面看上去只是个意外，可是李万生心知肚明，那就是章福民做的。这样的杀子之仇让他怎么不恨。更何况，因为流产的时候孩子已经六个月了，所以唐雪以后都不能再有孩子了。所以李万生这才真正和章福民离心，开始收集章福民的犯罪证据。而章玉凤也没能怀孕，以至于李万生现在都快四十了还没有孩子。
而章福民实在是太重口味了，他居然有两个老婆，这两个老婆还是亲姐妹，而且这还是他的岳父岳母都同意的。当然这只有很少的人知道，名义上阿依古丽只是他的小姨子，暂时借住在他家。但是有谁一借住借住了十多年，而且还不结婚的？这明显有猫腻。
这种事在开放的后世都很少见，可是没想到在青木这个小县城居然能让她看到这样的狗血大戏，当真是有趣。

Volume 1: Rebirth and Return Chapter 16: Thunderous Thunder and Heavy Taste
At this time, there was a commotion at the gate, and Wang Hailong, the owner of the Qingmu Hotel, trotted to the door of the hotel and invited a group of people in with a respectful look.
"Coming."
Tao Zexi lowered his head and whispered.
"The one walking in the middle with a mole on his right eyebrow is the local emperor of Qingmu, Zhang Fumin, and the one on his left is Li Wansheng."
As early as when the group of people came in, Su Rui had already "seen" the past of Zhang Fumin and Li Wansheng. When Zhang Fumin and his group disappeared at the turn of the stairs, Tao Zexi withdrew his attention. He was about to ask Su Rui what he had found, but found that Su Rui had already started eating.
"Hey, why did you eat it? Now everyone is upstairs and you can't see it even if you want to." That tone sounded a bit like iron can't turn into steel.
"I think this dish will get cold if you don't eat it, and it won't taste good if it's cold. What a waste. Eat it quickly. I can't finish it by myself. I really like this big plate of chicken!"
Seeing Su Rui eating so deliciously made Tao Zexi feel hungry, and then he picked up his chopsticks and started a food fight with Su Rui.
"Did you see Li Wansheng? Did you see anything?" Tao Zexi asked when he saw that Su Rui had almost eaten.
"Walls have ears, let's go to where you live and let's talk."
"What did you really see?" Tao Zexi asked anxiously after closing the door.
Seeing Tao Zexi's irritable look, Su Rui sat leisurely on the chair with smiles in her eyes.
"Well, I'm a little thirsty."
Tao Zexi saw that she was like, "I won't speak until you give me a drink of water." So he had no choice but to pour her a glass of water.
Su Rui took the water glass, took a sip along the rim, and finally put it down when Tao Zexi couldn't help but speak again.
"I did see something. This Li Wansheng is obviously not compatible with Zhang Fumin. Although it seems that Li Wansheng is following Zhang Fumin's lead, and he also married Zhang Fumin's sister Zhang Yufeng, which makes them even more tied together. But what if Zhang Fumin hates Li Wansheng for killing his son? Will he still share the same heart with Zhang Fumin?"
Su Rui said it lightly, but the more she downplayed it, the more surprised Tao Zexi was. How did she know that Zhang Fumin had a murderous hatred for Li Wansheng? Such important information was not even investigated by a special soldier like him, but this fourteen-year-old girl could actually get such information just by meeting Li Wansheng. If this is true, then who is Su Rui?
This really shocked Tao Zexi. He looked at Su Rui with doubts and scrutiny.
Su Rui chuckled lightly when she saw the confusion and scrutiny in Tao Zexi's eyes.
"Why are you looking at me like this? We have a common enemy, don't we?"
"You...can you read faces?" Tao Zexi asked cautiously.
"Oh, almost. You can think so too."
Tao Zexi quickly adjusted his expression, but looked at Su Rui with a hint of awe. Maybe many people don't believe in Feng Shui, but he does believe in it. The more powerful those big people are, the more they believe in it. Moreover, when he was performing tasks, he also encountered things that ordinary people could not explain. Fire Lions have Feng Shui consultants. Whenever they encounter supernatural events that cannot be explained, they need Feng Shui consultants to come forward and solve them. So he couldn't help but not believe it.
"As for the evidence collected by Li Wansheng, you can go to the residence of his childhood sweetheart Tang Xue. It's in the drawer of the bedroom closet. As for Zhang Fumin, you can check the bank account of his wife's sister Ayiguli."
Tao Zexi's expression is very complicated. Can physiognomy be able to see it in such detail? If he could really do it, wouldn't Su Rui be more powerful than those masters of metaphysics? But how old is she? If you tell me, no one will believe it.
Su Rui originally only wanted to see Li Wansheng's past, but she didn't expect to meet Zhang Fumin at the same time.She met two people at the same time the day before, so she could only see through one of them, so her skills were too weak. She was able to see through two at once thanks to the four luminous pearls. After her master left the study last night, she took the luminous pearl and looked at it. Unexpectedly, the luminous pearl actually contained purple energy. The purple energy was flowing into her body little by little. If she hadn't been observing the luminous pearl, she would have never seen it. You wouldn't have discovered that now that she knew the luminous pearl contained purple energy, Su Rui had no reason to let it go. However, she still carefully absorbed the first luminous pearl. After finding that there was no change in the luminous pearl, she boldly absorbed the other three. Su Ruike had no scruples about absorbing the other three, so she quickly absorbed them. When she finished absorbing the fourth Night Pearl, she found that she was about to break through the first level. This was her first breakthrough, so naturally she did not dare to neglect, and immediately crossed her legs and entered meditation. Finally, at dawn, he successfully broke through with the help of the purple energy between heaven and earth. That's why she was able to "see" the past of two people today without any difficulty at all. Su Rui silently gave thirty-two likes to the founder Tianjizi in her heart. This is really a super golden finger.
As for the pasts of Li Wansheng and Zhang Fumin, Su Rui really couldn't bear to look at them. One of them was a bitter mandarin duck in a city filled with blood and thunder, and the other was a pair of heavy-tasting sisters who shared a husband.
It is said that Li Wansheng was an ambitious young man who wanted to serve the people wholeheartedly. However, after arriving in Qingmu County, reality shattered his ideals. At that time, Zhang Fumin was already the local emperor in Qingmu County, and Zhang Fumin felt that Li Wansheng was very talented, so he wanted Li Wansheng to be his right-hand man. Li Wansheng wanted to fight against Zhang Fumin, but he almost got himself involved, so he had no choice but to join in with Zhang Fumin. Then he gradually felt the benefits that money brought to him, so he got lost in money and couldn't extricate himself.
Li Wansheng originally thought that it would be good to establish a foothold here, and then take over his childhood sweetheart, get married and have children. In Qingmu County, he is considered to be one person below ten thousand people, and he can give his lover a good life. He had a good idea, but unfortunately people's calculations are not as good as God's calculations. In order to strengthen his relationship with Li Wansheng, Zhang Fumin wanted to marry his sister, who was eight years older than Li Wansheng, to him. Li Wansheng didn't want to marry him, but Zhang Fumin used evidence of his crime to force him to marry Zhang Yufeng.
He used to be a man with ideals and blood, not to mention that he already had a lover in his heart. He couldn't let go of his childhood sweetheart. In the end, it was his childhood sweetheart who persuaded him to marry Zhang Yufeng and told him that he was willing to be younger. In the end, Li Wansheng had no choice but to marry Zhang Yufeng.
Since Li Wansheng and Zhang Yufeng got married, he bought another house in Qingmu County and brought his lover over to have a golden nest. Zhang Fumin knew that Li Wansheng had raised a child outside, but he thought it was nothing. For a man, it was normal to have three wives and four concubines, not to mention that he was the same. This is how he comforted his sister. But when Li Wansheng's childhood sweetheart became pregnant, Zhang Fumin became uneasy. Even if Li Wansheng wanted to have a child, he could only give birth to his sister. The bond of marriage is too fragile. As long as his sister gives birth to his child, he will definitely not betray the Zhang family. So he had Tang Xue aborted. Although it looked like an accident on the surface, Li Wansheng knew full well that it was Zhang Fumin who did it. How could he not hate such revenge for killing his son? What's more, because the child was already six months old when she had the miscarriage, Tang Xue could not have any more children in the future. That's why Li Wansheng really broke away from Zhang Fumin and began to collect Zhang Fumin's criminal evidence. And Zhang Yufeng failed to get pregnant, so Li Wansheng is now almost forty and still has no children.And Zhang Fumin is so picky that he actually has two wives, and these two wives are biological sisters, and this is something that both his father-in-law and mother-in-law agree with. Of course, only a few people knew this. In name, Ayiguli was just his sister-in-law, temporarily staying at his house. But who has lived here for more than ten years without getting married? This is obviously fishy.
This kind of thing is rare in the later generations of openness, but she didn't expect that she could see such a bloody drama in a small county like Qingmu. It was really interesting.
